title: Native finite open support is closed under ambient tensor
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, schemes X and Z in universe u, an open immersion j:X -> Z and a natural number n. For every module M over the finite constant coefficient sheaf on X and every module N on Z at positive quotient level n+1, the ordinary sheaf tensor of StrictTower.moduleJ M with N lies in the essential image of StrictTower.moduleJ at that same finite coefficient ring. The tensor and coefficient conventions are those of def-coef-native-open-tensor-primitives and def-coef-native-open-tensor-evaluation-data. No cochain, derived, sequence-site or unit normalization datum is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0E8I, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; the essential-image consequence after native open slice presentation.

proof.text: Present native open extension as an equivalence e from open modules to modules on the ambient slice, followed by literal localized extension L. This presentation uses precisely the given finite constant coefficient ring and is valid also for the empty open.

For the slice module e(M) and ambient module N, take S to be sheafification of the sectionwise tensor of e(M) with N restricted to the slice. The ringed-slice tensor theorem identifies L(S) with the sheafification of the presheaf tensor of L(e(M)) and N. The canonical tensor/sheafification isomorphism identifies the latter with their ordinary sheaf tensor.

Use e.inverse(S) as the open witness. The extension-presentation isomorphism and the image under L of the counit e(e.inverse(S)) -> S identify its extension with L(S). Compose the previous tensor comparison and tensor the extension-presentation isomorphism for M with identity on N. This gives the required essential-image witness. No monoidal structure on e is needed, and no data are chosen from an unproved mere-existence theorem.

theorem nativeFiniteTensor_mem_essImage
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] (n : ℕ)
    (M : normalizedDVRModules.{u, u} l E X n)
    (N : normalizedDVRModules.{u, u} l E Z n) :
    (ProEtale.StrictTower.moduleJ (compactSupportSystemLevel l E n) j).essImage
      (ordinaryTensor.{u + 1, u, u} (ProEt.topology Z)
        (ProEtale.StrictTower.coefficients (compactSupportSystemLevel l E n) Z)
        ((ProEtale.StrictTower.moduleJ (compactSupportSystemLevel l E n) j).obj M) N)
